project_tracker_diagnostic: Annual with opposite lower leaves, bright yellow rays, and gray-green somewhat woolly foliage; very different from frostweed despite sharing the genus.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common or useful Central Texas fall/white composite for field learning.

morphology_keys.leaves: Lower leaves opposite, upper alternate; blades triangular to ovate, coarsely toothed to lobed, often gray-green and somewhat hairy.
morphology_keys.heads: Showy yellow rays with yellow disks.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
